_source.title: 阻焊/助焊扩展
_source.remarks.text.0: 本参数设置包含以下三类情况：
_source.remarks.text.1: 1. 当图元为顶层/底层贴片焊盘时，允许设置对应层的阻焊/助焊扩展，其余设置不生效
_source.remarks.text.2: 2. 当图元为通孔焊盘时，允许设置顶层/底层的阻焊扩展，助焊扩展的设置不生效
_source.remarks.text.3: 3. 当图元为过孔时，允许设置顶层/底层的阻焊扩展，助焊扩展的设置不生效，如若为盲孔，则视其暴露层生效其阻焊扩展设置
_source.remarks.text.4: 助焊扩展在一般情况下仅用于钢网生产等特定用途，不了解其作用请安心地忽略其参数设置

title: Solder mask / paste mask expansion
remarks.text.0: This parameter setting includes the following three cases:
remarks.text.1: 1. When the primitive is a top/bottom layer SMD pad, the solder mask/paste mask expansion of the corresponding layer can be set; other settings have no effect
remarks.text.2: 2. When the primitive is a through-hole pad, the solder mask expansion of the top/bottom layer can be set; paste mask expansion settings have no effect
remarks.text.3: 3. When the primitive is a via, the solder mask expansion of the top/bottom layer can be set; paste mask expansion settings have no effect. If it is a blind via, its solder mask expansion setting takes effect according to its exposed layer
remarks.text.4: The paste mask expansion is generally only used for specific purposes such as stencil production. If you do not understand its function, feel free to ignore its parameter settings
